insights.one_liner: PGGM is a not-for-profit pension provider in Zeist managing €271 billion for healthcare-sector workers; IND recognised sponsor.

culture.text: A not-for-profit cooperative pension provider with about 1,740 employees, headquartered in Zeist.
Staff often come from Utrecht University, Hogeschool Utrecht, VU, UvA and Erasmus, in economics, business, law and finance.
Its LinkedIn page is written mainly in Dutch, suggesting Dutch is common in daily work.

open.text: PGGM N.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.

growth.text: Managed €271 billion in pension assets for about 5.8-6.0 million participants on 30 June 2026.
Set up a JPY 120 billion investment partnership in Japan with Lendlease.
